shotGroups.name: Bus passenger’s perspective (Shots 5-6)
shotGroups.narrativeArc: Shen Xingqing expressed her intention in a low voice, then packed her bags and looked out the window. As the bus accelerated into Qingshi Town, her mood changed from seriousness to calm anticipation.
shotGroups.groupAudioDesign: The sound of slight airflow is maintained in the first 3 seconds to highlight the clarity of dialogue; the sound of synchronized zippers in the third second is used as the transition point, and then the ambient sound smoothly transitions to the sound of the bus's accelerating engine and the increasing wind sound, creating a sense of spatial flow.

shotGroups.name: Viewpoint 1 (Lens 1-2)
shotGroups.narrativeArc: Ma Yihua religiously placed figures of NBA stars under the dilapidated playground basketball hoop, and made a wish to improve her shooting percentage, creating a sense of mystery and solemnity that seeks solace in the absurd reality.
shotGroups.groupAudioDesign: The first 5 seconds are based on the sound of the sultry wind in the afternoon and the chirping of cicadas in the distance, highlighting the crisp and detailed sounds of the base of the figure hitting the concrete floor, creating a quiet atmosphere; at the end of the fourth second, the sound of clothes rubbing against each other begins, and transitioning to the last four seconds, the ambient sound is lowered to focus on the dialogue, and the sound of wind is kept as the background, and the mood changes from mysterious to obsessive piety.
